build_EGNN_dynamics_model: build an EGNN dynamics model to predict molecular position updates from a batch of atom positions and edges
create_EGNN_dynamics_torsion_model: create an EGNN dynamics torsion model to compute torsion-aware position gradients for molecular conformation sampling
build_SimpleMLP_model: build a SimpleMLP neural network with sinusoidal time embeddings for particle system dynamics prediction
create_E_GCL_layer: create an equivariant graph convolution layer for message passing on molecular graphs with node and edge features
run_update_batch_for_fairchem: run update_batch_for_fairchem to prepare a batch object with atom counts, positions, and atomic numbers for FairChem compatibility
